name: Cove Split Scenes
description: Split selected videos at chapter markers, with fades-to-black fallback, without reencoding. Optional import, Identify and AI Faces.
author: jiwenji

versions.changelog:
# Split Scenes 0.1.7

- Shows a scissors icon for Split Scenes in the individual video Operations menu and the selection bar.
- Includes compatibility with Cove builds that ignore the declared extension action icon and always render a puzzle piece. Other actions and loading indicators keep their existing icons.
